title: Synthesis and molecular structure of [Sm4Ti(μ5-O)(μ3-OR)2(μ-OR)6(OR)6] (R = Pri): a novel framework for heteronuclear alkoxides with a 1:4 stoichiometry

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations under argon (Schlenk/vacuum line). Samarium chips (1.3 g, 9.18 mmol) activated by mercuric salts [HgCl2 + Hg(OAc)2 (1:1, 10 mg)] in 60 cm3 of toluene–isopropanol (1:1) were heated under reflux for 36 h. After cooling to room temperature and filtration, Ti(OPri)4 (0.61 ml, 2.07 mmol) was added to the yellow filtrate. The solution was stirred at room temperature for 72 h. Colourless, air-sensitive crystals of 1 (2.2 g, 71%) were obtained at −20 °C. The same product was also obtained by reaction of SmI2 (2 g, 4.89 mmol) with NaTi(OPri)5 (3.58 g, 9.78 mmol) under reflux for 3 h in THF; after filtration, concentration, and addition of hexane, crystallization over about 1 week gave 1 (1 g, 56% based on Sm). The paper also notes formation in higher yield (71% vs 56%) by reacting Sm5O(OPri)13 and Ti(OPri)4 in 1:4 stoichiometry at room temperature in toluene–isopropanol.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (36 h, Sm chips route); room temperature (72 h after Ti addition); crystallization at −20 °C; alternative metathesis reflux 3 h in THF; Lewis acid–base route at room temperature
synthesis.time: 36 h reflux then 72 h stirring (primary route); 3 h reflux then ~1 week crystallization (metathesis route)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tubes and vacuum-line techniques under argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool, filter, add Ti(OPri)4, stir, crystallize colourless crystals at −20 °C. Metathesis route: filter, concentrate, add hexane; complete crystallization ~1 week as the solution turns yellow.
synthesis.yield: 2.2 g, 71% (Sm chips/Ti(OPri)4 route); 1 g, 56% based on samarium (SmI2/NaTi(OPri)5 route)

properties.summary: Solid-state magnetic susceptibility was measured; the effective moment is μ = 2.542 μB. A crude diamagnetic brown intermediate from the SmI2 metathesis was noted but not fully characterized.
